about: Source strings (French / English). Each national-language file (lang/<code>.json) maps an id to { t, verified, validator, audio }. {placeholders} are filled with the protected values from the page (amounts, names...) and MUST be kept in the translation. Strings marked "check": true were taken from an auto-translated view of the test page and must be compared with the page's real FR/EN text.

entries.fr: Quelles sont les étapes du virement ?

Un virement a cinq étapes. Payer lance le virement. Frais : choisissez le type et le montant, et vérifiez les frais. Bénéficiaire : le nom et le numéro de téléphone de la personne qui reçoit. Récapitulatif : vérifiez tout. Confirmation : le virement part seulement quand vous confirmez.
entries.en: A transfer has five steps. Pay starts the transfer. Costs lets you choose the type and amount and check the fee. Beneficiary asks for the recipient name and phone number. Summary lets you review the details. Confirmation sends it only after you confirm.
